items.headline: Apollo again limits withdrawals from private credit fund as 14.7% of investors seek to exit
items.summary: Apollo has capped redemptions from a private credit fund for a second time after 14.7% of investors sought to exit. The firm joins other managers restricting withdrawals amid a rush to exit driven by concerns over loan quality.
items.why_it_matters: The repeat gating adds to signs of stress across private credit portfolios, coming weeks after regulators flagged the Bathla collapse and warned of more enforcement in the sector.

items.headline: Alibaba to build data centres in Europe and Middle East, escalating cloud rivalry with AWS, Google
items.summary: Alibaba plans to add data centres in Europe and the Middle East, extending its cloud buildout beyond Asia and going head-to-head with Amazon and Alphabet in those regions. The move follows Alibaba's target, set this week, for its global data-centre capacity to exceed 20 gigawatts by 2032.
items.why_it_matters: Extending into new regions sharpens the US-China contest for AI infrastructure and signals Alibaba is moving quickly to execute on its stated capacity target.

items.headline: Australian healthtech Heidi raises $100m in Series C round
items.summary: Heidi, an Australian healthcare startup, has raised $100 million in a Series C funding round.
items.why_it_matters: A round of this size for an Australian healthcare startup points to continued strength in growth-stage healthtech financing in the region.

items.headline: Nexstrom raises $12m seed round to build 2D semiconductor platform
items.summary: Nexstrom has raised $12 million in a seed funding round to develop a 2D semiconductor platform.
items.why_it_matters: The seed round shows early-stage investors continuing to back novel semiconductor materials as AI-related chip demand grows.
